key_insight: The proposed framework combines ontology grounding with multi-agent reasoning to make differential diagnosis more explicit, traceable, and evidence-linked.
clinical_relevance: It aims to support reviewable diagnostic reasoning and targeted follow-up questions when patient descriptions are incomplete or ambiguous.
method: Ground diagnostic inference in a structured, expert-curated medical knowledge base.
Decompose differential diagnosis into explicit, auditable multi-agent reasoning steps.
Identify discriminative missing symptoms and generate targeted follow-up questions.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports publicly available source code but provides no dataset details, evaluation metrics, or quantitative results supporting its claimed improvements.
watch_item: Reliability may depend on ontology coverage and quality; clinical performance remains unestablished by the abstract.
paper_title: Ontology-guided multi-agent reasoning for explainable differential diagnosis
